# Giskard Red-Team Node

Adversarial vulnerability scanning for local agent councils via MCP.
Uses Giskard LLM to run automated red-teaming scans against agents on the fleet network.

## Quick start
- `uv sync` -- install dependencies
- `just mcp-http` -- start HTTP server on port 11056
- `just mcp` -- start stdio server for Claude Desktop
- `just docker-build && just docker-run` -- run in Docker

## Tools
- `run_red_team_scan` -- Run a Giskard adversarial scan against a target agent
- `list_scans` -- List previously run scans
- `get_scan_status` -- Server status and configuration

See [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt) for full documentation.
